works.body:
My name is Lucas and I am a new Vtuber.
I have seen your beautiful illustrations on Twitter.
I thought it would be a good fit for my illustration since he is a beautiful young man with an aesthetic style, so I requested it.
The background is up to you, but I would like to use it as a thumbnail, so I would appreciate it if you could include a PNG without the background.
